02 / What’s coming

Four pillars. One circuit.

Padel is doubling every year and the tooling hasn’t kept up. We’re building the four things South Florida players have been duct-taping together with group chats, spreadsheets, and DMs.

01

Match Play Finder

Stop messaging WhatsApp groups at 9pm hoping someone needs a fourth. See open matches at your level near you, posted by verified players, with ratings you can trust.

Find Your Game
02

Real Leagues

Weekly fixtures, real schedules, season-long standings. Compete locally without giving up your weeknights, with rating-based divisions and operator-run seasons.

Compete Weekly
03

Tournaments

Brackets that update in real time. Single elimination, round-robin, Swiss draws. Run a tournament for your club or play in one that matters across South Florida.

Win Something
04

Padel Community

Tiered chats by level, court reviews, gear talk, local pros. The corner of the internet where Florida padel actually lives — not buried in 14 different group chats.

Find Your People
03 / Match Play Finder

The end of “anyone need a 4th?”

You shouldn’t have to scroll through three group chats and a dozen DMs to find a court. See who’s playing your level near you, post your availability, and lock in a match in under a minute.

  • Filter by level — verified ratings, not self-reporting
  • Top Players Nearby with profile and tier at a glance
  • Match cards with venue, time, court, and open spots
  • Direct check-in and score reporting from the same screen
04 / Leagues

Standings that actually mean something.

Real leagues, run weekly, with rating-based divisions and a points system that rewards playing up. Every match counts. Every season ends with a champion. Every player has somewhere to climb.

  • Auto-generated round-robin schedules with real fixtures
  • Live standings updated as scores are reported
  • Confirm lineups, check in, report scores — all in one place
  • Open leagues anyone can join — or invite-only for clubs
05 / Tournaments

Brackets, draws, real money on the line.

One-day shootouts. Weekend Swiss draws. Club championships with cash prizes. The infrastructure to run a tournament that feels professional — and the chance to actually win something when you enter.

  • Cash prize pools, gear payouts, and trophy events — not participation ribbons
  • Single elimination, round-robin, or Swiss-style draws
  • Auto-seeded brackets based on combined team rating
  • Live bracket updates as scores are reported in real time

06 / Tiered Chats

The conversation, matched to your level.

Group chats sorted by skill tier and city. Find pickup games at your level, swap court intel, organize your league, and meet the players you actually want to play. No more digging through fourteen WhatsApp groups.

  • Tier-based chats from Beginner through Elite, gated by verified rating
  • City-specific channels for Miami, Brickell, Aventura, Boca, and beyond
  • Dedicated chats for every league and tournament you join
  • DMs for partners, captains, and the people you regularly play

07 / Your Profile

Your padel, tracked.

Every match. Every win. Every step up the rating ladder. PadelCircle keeps the receipts so you can see exactly how your game is progressing — over a season, over a year, over a career.

  • Verified rating with progression toward the next tier
  • Match history, win rate, streaks, and points differential
  • Achievement badges that unlock as you play and climb
  • League and tournament results archived to your profile
08 / Community

Built with the players, not at them.

PadelCircle started in South Florida because we couldn’t find a single place where the community lived. We’re shipping it the way we’d want to use it — with input from organizers, club owners, and the players who show up week after week.

If you run a league, host tournaments, or just play a lot, we want to hear from you. We’re prioritizing access for early operators and players who help shape what the platform becomes.
